messages:
maria_csops: Heads-up — noticed ~120 accounts didn't get the onboarding playbook triggers after yesterday's CRM boolean field rename. healthscore stayed at 0 and no onboarding tasks queued :rotating_light:
jordan_csm: ugh, that's bad. which field changed? could be the field name mapping in the playbook condition set
maria_csops: we renamed `is_onboarded` -> `onboard_status_boolean` during the schema cleanup. playbook checks `is_onboarded = false` so nothing matched. ran a quick sample: `SELECT id FROM accounts WHERE onboard_status_boolean = false LIMIT 20;` returned expected rows but playbook-bot said "no eligible accounts"
playbook-bot: automated message: playbook 'onboard-new-accounts-v2' executed 2026-03-22T09:02Z — 0 matches — filter condition: `properties.is_onboarded == false`
sam_eng: looks like the playbook filter still references old property path. i can push a hotfix to the playbook config to point to `properties.onboard_status_boolean` — want me to do that now?
maria_csops: yes please. also worried about the healthscore calc — it uses onboarding touchpoints as input so customers might show as high-risk incorrectly
jordan_csm: for mitigation we should backfill the playbook events + rerun healthscore for affected accounts. can we script a dry-run first?
sam_eng: plan: 1) update playbook filter to new field (quick rollbackable change) 2) run a dry-run to capture the candidate list 3) enqueue playbook events for backfill for the 120 accounts 4) trigger healthscore recalculation hook
leo_enablement: i can message the affected CSMs with a short template about the glitch and that we backfilled touchpoints. also want to capture any customer-facing feedback — I'll add a short survey to the follow-up email
maria_csops: thanks. Jordan — can you compile the list of affected owners? we should avoid duplicate nudges.
jordan_csm: on it. pulling owner mapping now and will attach in #cs-owners later.
sam_eng: pushed playbook filter change to staging and validated with dry-run: 118 matches. will push to prod in 5 if no objections
maria_csops: go ahead. after prod push, please run this backfill SQL (dry-run first):
```
-- dry-run: mark candidate playbook events
SELECT acct_id, owner_id FROM accounts WHERE onboard_status_boolean = false AND created_at > '2026-01-01' LIMIT 200;
```
then:
```
-- enqueue events (example)
INSERT INTO playbook_events (account_id, playbook, created_by) SELECT acct_id, 'onboard-new-accounts-v2', 'maria_csops' FROM staging_candidates;
```
sam_eng: will run dry-run and post counts. after enqueue we'll trigger healthscore-job for that account batch
playbook-bot: automated message: backfill job queued by sam_eng — batch id bf-20260322-1 — estimated 5m runtime
maria_csops: perfect. leo — include a single-question feedback link: "Did the onboarding touchpoints you received match expectations? (yes/no)" — record responses to cs-feedback tag
leo_enablement: done. template drafted and ready to send once backfill completes :white_check_mark:
jordan_csm: attached owner list in #cs-owners. will coordinate manual outreach for any high-touch customers
maria_csops: postmortem notes for later: 1) add a playschema lint check for property renames 2) add a healthscore dependency test when playbook filters change 3) small ops runbook for boolean field renames
sam_eng: agree. i'll open a tech ticket for lint + preflight checks against playbook filters
maria_csops: thanks team — keeping this thread open until backfill + healthscore rerun confirmed. :eyes:
